summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce routine treasury operations: during August 17–21, 2026, it purchased 1,110 bitcoin at an average price of about $73,409 per bitcoin, funded by proceeds from sales of Class A common stock and Series A perpetual preferred stock (SATA). The filing also provided an updated balance sheet showing increases in cash, bitcoin, and share counts. This is a periodic update on crypto treasury and equity issuances, not a special situation. No transaction terms, advisors, or board actions are involved. What to watch: continued bitcoin accumulation and equity dilution trends.
